claim: Hayabusa2 "was" a mission; status En Route

suggestion.from: The mission provided invaluable insights into the composition of carbon-rich asteroids and the history of the early Solar System.
suggestion.to: The mission provided invaluable insights into the composition of carbon-rich asteroids and the history of the early Solar System. The spacecraft is now on an extended mission: it flew past asteroid Torifune on 5 July 2026 and is due to reach the tiny asteroid 1998 KY26 in 2031.
